create_apartment_listing_app: create an ApartmentListingApp instance to manage apartment listings with CRUD operations
add_new_apartment: add a new apartment with name, location, price, bedrooms, and amenities to the listing
search_apartments: search apartments by location, price range, bedrooms, amenities, or saved status
save_apartment: save an apartment to favorites by its apartment_id for quick access later
update_apartment_price: update the price of an existing apartment by its apartment_id
